description: This file defines a custom exception class DuplicateConceptNameException used in the OpenMRS API to handle duplicate concept name errors.

classes.name: DuplicateConceptNameException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a duplicate concept name exists within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: DuplicateConceptNameException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating a duplicate concept name.

methods.name: DuplicateConceptNameException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be specified for the duplicate concept name exception.
